exceptions.description: Indebtedness (including Acquired Indebtedness) secured on a pari passu basis with the Secured Obligations may be incurred in an unlimited amount if the First Lien Leverage Ratio test is satisfied (Permitted Ratio Debt, category (1)).

Indebtedness secured on a Junior Lien Priority basis may be incurred in an unlimited amount if either the Senior Secured Leverage Ratio test or the Interest Coverage Ratio test is satisfied, at the Initial Borrower's discretion (Permitted Ratio Debt, category (2)).

Unsecured Indebtedness may be incurred in an unlimited amount if either the Total Leverage Ratio test or the Interest Coverage Ratio test is satisfied, at the Initial Borrower's discretion (Permitted Ratio Debt, category (3)).

Additional categories of Indebtedness are excluded from this prohibition entirely, as enumerated in Section 6.01(b); the substantive enumerated list itself was not included in the supplied source region for this compilation (only the lead-in clause was returned).
